'''Paet al'Caar''' is a [[Two Rivers]] resident.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Paet al'Caar}} His son is [[Wil al'Caar]].

== Appearance ==
He has a lantern jaw.

== Activities ==
After the [[Trolloc]]s first attack [[Emond's Field]], he is part of the crowd that confronts [[Moiraine Damodred]] demanding she leave at once, even though she [[Heal]]ed his son's leg after the attack. He is the first to apologize to her.

He helps defend [[Emond's Field]] against the invading Trolloc army.{{ref/book|4|56}}
